title: Give named_root_bind's exited-session and actor-mismatch refusals their own error codes so TermAl can tell a curable refusal from the others
outcome: Give named_root_bind's exited-session and actor-mismatch refusals their own error codes so TermAl can tell a curable refusal from the others
acceptance: named_root_bind reports a refusal caused by an Exited control session with its own stable code (for example control_session_exited), distinct from named_root_binding_refused
named_root_bind reports an actor/session mismatch with its own stable code, distinct from the exited case
all other named_root_bind refusals (field rules, workspace text, end rules, inactive claim, stale generation) keep named_root_binding_refused
the host protocol documentation lists the new codes, and tests assert each code from the corresponding branch
